profile.headline: Sr Staff Software Engineer at ServiceNow
profile.summary:
Strong engineering professional with a BS focused in Computer Science, Mathematics from California State University-San Marcos, with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry.  Passionate about building great user experiences while constantly learning and utilizing new front-end technologies to continue to push the boundaries of what is achievable. 

A team player that loves to work with other experienced co-workers to help evolve the technology stack building modern and awesome user experience for our customers. Possess a solid understanding of building amazing, performant and scalable user interfaces with large scale data, an obsession with design aesthetics, and engineering excellence.

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Contribute and participate in reviews for architecture, design, and code for the core platform.  Build scalable and reliable cloud solutions to support the rapid growth of SaaS Application suites offered on the Dreamtsoft platform.  Train and mentor customers and new Employees on Platform APIs and Application lifecycle.

positions.title: Sr. Manager, Software Engineering
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Manage product development activities in a high pace environment.  Responsible for the overall systems development life cycle for product implementation as well as custom built web applications on ServiceNow platform.  Work closely with product management, UX and support/satellite teams for new features and upgrades.  Management and execution against project plans and delivery commitments.
Contribute and participate in reviews for architecture, design and code. 
Exercise appropriate influence to ensure commitment to customers and deliverable quality products.
Manage the day-to-day activities of the development team within an Agile/Scrum environment.
Management of departmental resource, staffing, mentoring, and enhancing & maintaining a best-of-class platform development team.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:

•	Proven Web software development experience
•	Strong Java programming skills
•	HTML and XHTML, XML, CSS
•	JavaScript and AJAX experience
•	Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL
•	Strong personal commitment to quality
•	Experience dealing with customers and end-users

positions.title: Architect, Expert Services
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:

•	Architect new ways of solving problems using the ServiceNow platform 
•	Create, deliver, and evangelize new Services products, tools, and frameworks 
•	Create, document, and evangelize ServiceNow configuration best practices
•	Work with Product Management and Development teams providing feedback,  commoditizing specialized parts of the application, and moving commonly made  changes into the product 
•	Drive the continuous improvements of our implementation methodology and service offerings based on client experiences
•	Act as a billable resource delivering Expert Services packages including: workshops, configuration reviews, and Expert Assist
•	Maintain a billable utilization of 50% or above
•	Prepare all client facing and internal deliverables that are technology related
•	Inspire customer confidence through professional presence, self-confidence, and resolution of technical issues
•	Quickly absorb information; express and implement workable solutions in real time
